sys_variable_set.title: Request a DDI-backed subnet
sys_variable_set.description: Front-door variable set; each variable maps to one AWS module tfvar (see map_to). The contract test keeps this ⊇ the module's required variables.

item_option_new.name: target_platform
item_option_new.help_text: Selects the module + validation scripts; this variable set is the AWS instance.

item_option_new.name: region
item_option_new.help_text: Commercial AWS region. Pick-list of approved regions; no default.

item_option_new.name: network_account_id
item_option_new.help_text: Stage-1 output — reference lookup, not free-typed.

item_option_new.name: hub_vpc_id
item_option_new.help_text: Stage-1 output; hub VPC ID. Pre-populated reference.

item_option_new.name: transit_gateway_id
item_option_new.help_text: Stage-1 output; transit gateway ID. Pre-populated reference.

item_option_new.name: ddi_subnet_cidrs
item_option_new.help_text: Must fit the hub, no overlap. Pre-flight + gate conflict-check it.

item_option_new.name: availability_zones
item_option_new.help_text: AZs to spread the subnet across; region-dependent pick-list.

item_option_new.name: vnios_instance_type
item_option_new.help_text: Region/NIOS-version dependent; pick-list of approved instance types.

item_option_new.name: vnios_ami_id
item_option_new.help_text: vNIOS AMI ID; pick-list per region, do not hard-code a version.

item_option_new.name: dns_client_cidrs
item_option_new.help_text: Spoke/on-prem ranges permitted to query DNS.

item_option_new.name: environment
item_option_new.help_text: dev|test|prod — drives tags/sizing and the approval tier.

item_option_new.name: acknowledge_saas_boundary
item_option_new.help_text: Required true only for universal_ddi; drives an extra approval.

item_option_new.name: host_fqdn
item_option_new.help_text: Registered as the A + PTR for the allocated host IP. Consumed by the Flow, not a module tfvar.

item_option_new.name: business_justification
item_option_new.help_text: Read first by the approver. Flow/record field, not a module tfvar.
